description: Land Title Settlement Department - Uththupitiya, Thirappane D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110590 (23/0216)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and declarations regarding specific parcels of land. It involves the Commissioner of Title Settlement making determinations about land ownership and classifications under the Registration of Title Act. The content includes detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership status (all listed as "The State"), and specific land reservations (for roads, canals, cemeteries, public affairs, etc.). This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
